{{alias}}( x )
    Evaluates the digamma function for a single-precision floating-point
    number.

    If `x` is zero or a negative integer, the function returns `NaN`.

    If provided `NaN`, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.

    Returns
    -------
    y: number
        Function value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 1.0 )
    ~-0.577
    > y = {{alias}}( -2.0 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( 3.0 )
    ~0.923
    > y = {{alias}}( -2.5 )
    ~1.103
    > y = {{alias}}( 0.0 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( NaN )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
